items.name: Z-algorithm
items.description: Compute longest common prefixes from each string position using the Z-algorithm.

items.name: Rotation matching
items.description: Reduce string rotation equality to pattern matching in a doubled string.

items.name: Suffix array
items.description: Build or use a suffix array to order suffixes of a string or sequence.

items.name: LCP array
items.description: Build or use longest-common-prefix values between adjacent suffix-array entries.

items.name: Distinct substring counting
items.description: Count distinct substrings or subarrays using suffix ordering, LCP subtraction, or equivalent structure.

items.name: Run-length encoding
items.description: Compress consecutive equal symbols into runs and reason over run values or lengths.

items.name: Suffix automaton
items.description: Build or use a suffix automaton to represent substrings and transitions.

items.name: String game DP
items.description: Model game states over strings, substrings, or string automata and compute winning states.

items.name: Lexicographic comparator
items.description: Compare strings or concatenations lexicographically using LCP or equivalent structure.
